build.anchorPolicy: fixed sprite baseline at (64,116); one shared integer translation keeps the lowest outlined pixel on or above it while preserving natural perspective depth and gait motion

poseAudit.directionSampling: one keyed action; only armature Z rotation changes per direction

ground.bodyGrounding: lowest evaluated vertex translated to world Z=0 per timeline frame
